description: NF-based Q-value computation (corrected Hecke σ⁻¹ = σ−h). Stage 1: free neutron quark-level calibration of E_q. Stage 2: nucleon-level NF for β⁻ decay isotopes.

crossing_convention.reference: upstream Hecke-Skein fix, sigma_inv = sigma - (q - q^-1)

codata_source.citation: CODATA 2022, NIST Physics Laboratory, Gaithersburg MD 20899 USA. Q = m_n - m_p - m_e derived from individual mass-energy equivalents; cross-checked against direct CODATA entry m_n-m_p = 1.2933321 MeV.

free_neutron.model: quark level H3(q) with Borromean B3=(sigma0*sigma1^-1)^3
free_neutron.status: exact by construction (E_q is calibrated from this)

diagnosis.observation: Nucleon-level Δ_A ≈ Δ_q for all light nuclei: r ≈ 1. Q_pred(³H) ≈ Q_NEUTRON, far above observed 0.019 MeV.
diagnosis.root_cause: With corrected Hecke inverse (c=1, d=-h), the matrices T_pp and T_nn differ only in the constant term. The nucleon-level Δ_A is insensitive to nuclear binding. Binding suppression enters only at quark level (L1).
diagnosis.next_step: Quark-level (L1) computation for ³H and 14C via Rust hecke-engine with corrected crossing convention.
